text_block_list.text:
After school, Mayano Top Gun called out to 
Hishi Amazon as she ran along the 
riverbed—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~, it's Hishi Ama-san! Whatcha 
doing~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Mayano. Just out for a run to lose 
some weight.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, could that possibly be for Trainer's 
sake!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Why are you bringing Trainer into this?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Making herself pretty for the one she 
likes... That's amazing~ She feels like 
such a mature woman!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't care how it looks. I just want 
to lighten my body for the race.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"There you go again~ No need to be shy☆ 
Mature romance, huh~ I totally look up to 
that~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What in the world are they talking 
about...? Well, whatever.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I'm heading back to my run. 
I've only done two laps to the bridge so 
far.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I gotta do 10 more laps before the 
day ends! Alright, let's keep running 
hard!

After diligently committing to a vigorous 
diet, Hishi Amazon quickly returned to her 
original weight.
